name: Horse
overview: The Bible presents horses as powerful instruments of war and symbols of great strength, as seen in the pursuit of the Israelites by Pharaoh's horses and chariots at the Red Sea, where God's deliverance was evident (Exodus 14:9; 15:19). While horses were used by both Egyptians and Israelites in battle, God commanded Joshua to disable enemy horses to ensure Israel's victory (Joshua 11:6, 9). Additionally, kings of Israel were instructed not to multiply horses or seek them from Egypt, highlighting a divine warning against relying on military might rather than trusting in the Lord (Deuteronomy 17:16).
